brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One full hex base with top and bottom covers (cover:0,0,0;full;top and ;bottom) and four solid side caps; capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied; check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Two hex-port-louvre ports on opposite side faces (port:0#0,0#0 and port:0#0,0#3). Louvre ports vent the cell without letting rain in, but airflow and the board's cooling were not simulated; the configurator checks fit only.
Configurator does not model airflow or thermal performance; no board or heat check was made.

finish.summary: Built a single full hex base enclosure (piece:0,0,0;full) closed with a solid top cover and solid bottom cover, four solid side caps (bearings 90, 150, 270, 330), and two louvred vent ports (hex-port-louvre) on the two opposite side faces (bearings 30 and 210) so air can pass through. Mesh check is clear with no rule errors. The one remaining info note is that the two louvre faces are intentionally left for the vents. Nothing dressed inside: the board itself is not part of the configurator, so no board or props were placed. Overall size about 220 x 80 x 218 mm.
